config.orbitvfx.enabled.tooltip: Turns all Orbit effects on or off.
config.orbitvfx.groundFog.tooltip: Low mist that settles in valleys, forests and swamps. Strongest around sunrise and in rain. Paused while a shader pack is active.
config.orbitvfx.lightScattering.tooltip: The mist glows in the color of the sky when looking towards the sun.
